description: Detect the most-recent closed_aborted session for an operator within a lookback window (INV-8). Read-only: never creates a session. Returns the candidate + requires_consent=true when found, so the caller can decide to follow up with session_resurrect.

lookback.description: Search window (default 24h). Formats: 24h, 7d, 30m, or Go duration.

operator.description: The human/agent identity to recover for (e.g. dark-agent).

name: dark_memory_session_recover
